<p>先看看现有方案。</p>
<p>大佬实现的：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fiyinchao%2Fliquid-glass-studio" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/iyinchao/liquid-glass-studio" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">github.com/iyinchao/li…</a>  效果非常牛逼，但是目前只能渲染图片对于html却无能为力。</p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/0ad3a993d40b44b9818addb3518e4689~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5oiR55qE5YiA55u-:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1790896677&amp;x-signature=ABT3Nzea9pTjQ8U8v%2BzZAu5WtOY%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>svg版本：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fvue-bits.dev%2Fcomponents%2Fglass-surface" target="_blank" title="https://vue-bits.dev/components/glass-surface" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">vue-bits.dev/components/…</a>  简单，但是存在致命问题，平滑度不够并会出现毛边且会出现颜色异常。</p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/a239036c2bd64a91bfaecd53a33e9b01~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5oiR55qE5YiA55u-:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1790896677&amp;x-signature=1znJ0fIL%2FH9gcv02bYxkvRapKrg%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/d525422a0213491d9fe8ff6b784958f8~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5oiR55qE5YiA55u-:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1790896677&amp;x-signature=3ZA%2BnfSXu4ucDnAk%2FdY3f5WEB5o%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>目前最好方案：three.js  +  webGL</p>
<p><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Freactbits.dev%2Fcomponents%2Ffluid-glass%3Fscale%3D0.2" target="_blank" title="https://reactbits.dev/components/fluid-glass?scale=0.2" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">fluid-glass</a></p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/c35e6c10bec44d9991b7cc02af72e8c8~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5oiR55qE5YiA55u-:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1790896677&amp;x-signature=AB2bR%2BGuKG2trv%2FOoiDcmTWGETQ%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>

<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/69f58c45b74a482a86f1dc978d4a6258~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5oiR55qE5YiA55u-:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1790896677&amp;x-signature=P0TLQdwakZOnF%2BBIKPrs7qEJ33U%3D" alt="余承东表情包制作需求 (1)_cleanup.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-id="heading-0">1. 渲染原理概览</h2>
<p>Fluid Glass 的核心是利用 <strong>FBO 离屏渲染</strong> 与 <strong>体积透射材质 (<code>MeshTransmissionMaterial</code>)</strong> 实现真 3D 光学折射与色散。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-1">数据流向：</h3>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/3769ec2d27c043989e7a07a279ea900e~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5oiR55qE5YiA55u-:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1790896677&amp;x-signature=YV4v5DPEA1kkzpxRWDSSbWawzGQ%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 data-id="heading-2">核心机制：</h3>
<ol>
<li><strong>Scene 隔离</strong>：背景文字与画廊通过 <code>createPortal</code> 挂载到独立离屏 <code>Scene</code>，不直接出现在主画布上。</li>
<li><strong>离屏烘焙</strong>：每帧渲染循环中，先将离屏 <code>Scene</code> 绘制到帧缓冲对象（FBO），生成背景纹理。</li>
<li><strong>单 Pass 折射采样</strong>：3D 玻璃网格直接使用该 FBO 纹理作为透射采样源，基于网格表面法线与光学参数（IOR、厚度、色散）计算折射偏移。</li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-3">2. 关键实现解析 (<code>FluidGlass.tsx</code>)</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-4">2.1 模型预加载与参数配置</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { memo, <span class="hljs-title class_">Suspense</span>, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, <span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ReactNode</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> * <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'three'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">Canvas</span>, createPortal, useFrame, useThree } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@react-three/fiber'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> {
  <span class="hljs-title class_">Image</span>,
  <span class="hljs-title class_">MeshTransmissionMaterial</span>,
  <span class="hljs-title class_">Preload</span>,
  <span class="hljs-title class_">Scroll</span>,
  <span class="hljs-title class_">ScrollControls</span>,
  <span class="hljs-title class_">Text</span>,
  useFBO,
  useGLTF,
  useScroll,
} <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@react-three/drei'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { easing } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'maath'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">FluidMode</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'lens'</span> | <span class="hljs-string">'cube'</span> | <span class="hljs-string">'bar'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">FluidGlassProps</span> = {
  mode?: <span class="hljs-title class_">FluidMode</span>;
  scale?: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>;
  ior?: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>;
  thickness?: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>;
  chromaticAberration?: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>;
  anisotropy?: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>;
};

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">LENS_GLB</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'/assets/3d/lens.glb'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">CUBE_GLB</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'/assets/3d/cube.glb'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">BAR_GLB</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'/assets/3d/bar.glb'</span>;

<span class="hljs-comment">// 预加载模型，避免切换形态时由于异步加载引发画面闪烁</span>
useGLTF.<span class="hljs-title function_">preload</span>(<span class="hljs-variable constant_">LENS_GLB</span>);
useGLTF.<span class="hljs-title function_">preload</span>(<span class="hljs-variable constant_">CUBE_GLB</span>);
useGLTF.<span class="hljs-title function_">preload</span>(<span class="hljs-variable constant_">BAR_GLB</span>);
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-5">2.2 核心包装器 <code>ModeWrapper</code>：事件与状态处理</h3>
<p><code>ModeWrapper</code> 负责状态管理、模型加载、事件监听与渲染管线调度。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ModeWrapperProps</span> = {
  children?: <span class="hljs-title class_">ReactNode</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attr">glb</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attr">geometryKey</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>;
  followPointer?: <span class="hljs-built_in">boolean</span>;
  lockToBottom?: <span class="hljs-built_in">boolean</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attr">modeProps</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Record</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, <span class="hljs-built_in">unknown</span>&gt;;
};

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ModeWrapper</span> = <span class="hljs-title function_">memo</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">ModeWrapper</span>(<span class="hljs-params">{
  children,
  glb,
  geometryKey,
  lockToBottom = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>,
  followPointer = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>,
  modeProps = {},
}: ModeWrapperProps</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> meshRef = useRef&lt;<span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-property">Mesh</span>&gt;(<span class="hljs-literal">null</span>);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> gltf = <span class="hljs-title function_">useGLTF</span>(glb);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> nodes = gltf.<span class="hljs-property">nodes</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Record</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-property">Mesh</span>&gt;;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> buffer = <span class="hljs-title function_">useFBO</span>(); <span class="hljs-comment">// 分配离屏 FBO 渲染目标</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { viewport, gl } = <span class="hljs-title function_">useThree</span>();
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> scene = <span class="hljs-title function_">useMemo</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Scene</span>(), []); <span class="hljs-comment">// 创建独立的离屏场景</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> geoWidthRef = <span class="hljs-title function_">useRef</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1</span>);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> pointerNDC = <span class="hljs-title function_">useRef</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Vector2</span>());

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 1. 获取模型包围盒尺寸，用于未指定 scale 时的自适应计算</span>
  <span class="hljs-title function_">useEffect</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> geo = nodes[geometryKey]?.<span class="hljs-property">geometry</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!geo) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
    geo.<span class="hljs-title function_">computeBoundingBox</span>();
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> box = geo.<span class="hljs-property">boundingBox</span>;
    geoWidthRef.<span class="hljs-property">current</span> = box ? box.<span class="hljs-property">max</span>.<span class="hljs-property">x</span> - box.<span class="hljs-property">min</span>.<span class="hljs-property">x</span> || <span class="hljs-number">1</span> : <span class="hljs-number">1</span>;
  }, [nodes, geometryKey]);

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 2. 指针事件监听与 NDC (归一化设备坐标) 转换</span>
  <span class="hljs-title function_">useEffect</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> canvas = gl.<span class="hljs-property">domElement</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">onMove</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">event: PointerEvent</span>) =&gt; {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> rect = canvas.<span class="hljs-title function_">getBoundingClientRect</span>();
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (rect.<span class="hljs-property">width</span> === <span class="hljs-number">0</span> || rect.<span class="hljs-property">height</span> === <span class="hljs-number">0</span>) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
      pointerNDC.<span class="hljs-property">current</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">set</span>(
        ((event.<span class="hljs-property">clientX</span> - rect.<span class="hljs-property">left</span>) / rect.<span class="hljs-property">width</span>) * <span class="hljs-number">2</span> - <span class="hljs-number">1</span>,
        -((event.<span class="hljs-property">clientY</span> - rect.<span class="hljs-property">top</span>) / rect.<span class="hljs-property">height</span>) * <span class="hljs-number">2</span> + <span class="hljs-number">1</span>,
      );
    };
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'pointermove'</span>, onMove);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">removeEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'pointermove'</span>, onMove);
  }, [gl]);
</code></pre>
<p>由于外层使用了 Drei 的 <code>ScrollControls</code>，滚动容器会劫持一部分默认事件，因此这里通过原生 <code>pointermove</code> 与 <code>canvas.getBoundingClientRect()</code> 自行计算归一化坐标。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-6">2.3 逐帧调度：<code>useFrame</code> 渲染循环</h3>
<p><code>useFrame</code> 回调由 <code>requestAnimationFrame</code> 驱动，在每一帧主画面渲染前执行：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript">  <span class="hljs-title function_">useFrame</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">state, delta</span>) =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> mesh = meshRef.<span class="hljs-property">current</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!mesh) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { gl, camera } = state;

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 计算透镜所在深度 (Z=15) 的视口尺寸</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> view = viewport.<span class="hljs-title function_">getCurrentViewport</span>(camera, [<span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">15</span>]);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> destX = followPointer ? (pointerNDC.<span class="hljs-property">current</span>.<span class="hljs-property">x</span> * view.<span class="hljs-property">width</span>) / <span class="hljs-number">2</span> : <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> destY = lockToBottom
      ? -view.<span class="hljs-property">height</span> / <span class="hljs-number">2</span> + <span class="hljs-number">0.2</span>
      : followPointer
        ? (pointerNDC.<span class="hljs-property">current</span>.<span class="hljs-property">y</span> * view.<span class="hljs-property">height</span>) / <span class="hljs-number">2</span>
        : <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 惯性平滑插值</span>
    easing.<span class="hljs-title function_">damp3</span>(mesh.<span class="hljs-property">position</span>, [destX, destY, <span class="hljs-number">15</span>], <span class="hljs-number">0.15</span>, delta);

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 自适应缩放</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (modeProps.<span class="hljs-property">scale</span> == <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> maxWorld = view.<span class="hljs-property">width</span> * <span class="hljs-number">0.9</span>;
      mesh.<span class="hljs-property">scale</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">setScalar</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">min</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0.15</span>, maxWorld / geoWidthRef.<span class="hljs-property">current</span>));
    }

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 将离屏 Scene 渲染进 FBO</span>
    gl.<span class="hljs-title function_">setRenderTarget</span>(buffer);
    gl.<span class="hljs-title function_">render</span>(scene, camera);
    gl.<span class="hljs-title function_">setRenderTarget</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">null</span>);
    gl.<span class="hljs-title function_">setClearColor</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0x5227ff</span>, <span class="hljs-number">1</span>);
  });
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-7">2.4 视口与坐标计算原理</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-8">1. 深度定在 <code>Z = 15</code></h4>
<ul>
<li>相机位置在 <code>Z = 20</code>（<code>camera={{ position: [0, 0, 20], fov: 15 }}</code>）。</li>
<li>场景背景内容分布在 <code>Z = 0 ~ 12</code>。</li>
<li>透镜放置在 <code>Z = 15</code>，位于相机与背景内容之间，使光线穿过玻璃后折射背景。</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-9">2. <code>view</code> 的作用</h4>
<p>在透视投影（Perspective Projection）下，视锥体会随深度变化：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>viewport.getCurrentViewport(camera, [0, 0, 15])</code> 用于计算在 <code>Z = 15</code> 切平面上，屏幕对应的世界坐标宽高（<code>view.width</code>, <code>view.height</code>）。</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-10">3. 坐标计算除以 2 的原因</h4>
<p>Three.js 场景原点 <code>(0, 0, 0)</code> 位于视口正中央：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>pointerNDC.x</code> 范围为 <code>[-1, 1]</code>。</li>
<li>视口正中为 <code>0</code>，最右边界为 <code>+view.width / 2</code>，最左边界为 <code>-view.width / 2</code>。</li>
<li>坐标换算公式：
<span class="math math-inline"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mtext>destX</mtext><mo>=</mo><mtext>pointerNDC.x</mtext><mo>×</mo><mfrac><mtext>view.width</mtext><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\text{destX} = \text{pointerNDC.x} \times \frac{\text{view.width}}{2}</annotation></semantics></math></span><span class="katex-html" aria-hidden="true"><span class="base"><span class="strut" style="height:0.6944em;"></span><span class="mord text"><span class="mord">destX</span></span><span class="mspace" style="margin-right:0.2778em;"></span><span class="mrel">=</span><span class="mspace" style="margin-right:0.2778em;"></span></span><span class="base"><span class="strut" style="height:0.8778em;vertical-align:-0.1944em;"></span><span class="mord text"><span class="mord">pointerNDC.x</span></span><span class="mspace" style="margin-right:0.2222em;"></span><span class="mbin">×</span><span class="mspace" style="margin-right:0.2222em;"></span></span><span class="base"><span class="strut" style="height:1.2251em;vertical-align:-0.345em;"></span><span class="mord"><span class="mopen nulldelimiter"></span><span class="mfrac"><span class="vlist-t vlist-t2"><span class="vlist-r"><span class="vlist" style="height:0.8801em;"><span style="top:-2.655em;"><span class="pstrut" style="height:3em;"></span><span class="sizing reset-size6 size3 mtight"><span class="mord mtight"><span class="mord mtight">2</span></span></span></span><span style="top:-3.23em;"><span class="pstrut" style="height:3em;"></span><span class="frac-line" style="border-bottom-width:0.04em;"></span></span><span style="top:-3.394em;"><span class="pstrut" style="height:3em;"></span><span class="sizing reset-size6 size3 mtight"><span class="mord mtight"><span class="mord text mtight"><span class="mord mtight">view.width</span></span></span></span></span></span><span class="vlist-s">​</span></span><span class="vlist-r"><span class="vlist" style="height:0.345em;"><span></span></span></span></span></span><span class="mclose nulldelimiter"></span></span></span></span></span></span>
<span class="math math-inline"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mtext>destY</mtext><mo>=</mo><mtext>pointerNDC.y</mtext><mo>×</mo><mfrac><mtext>view.height</mtext><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\text{destY} = \text{pointerNDC.y} \times \frac{\text{view.height}}{2}</annotation></semantics></math></span><span class="katex-html" aria-hidden="true"><span class="base"><span class="strut" style="height:0.6944em;"></span><span class="mord text"><span class="mord">destY</span></span><span class="mspace" style="margin-right:0.2778em;"></span><span class="mrel">=</span><span class="mspace" style="margin-right:0.2778em;"></span></span><span class="base"><span class="strut" style="height:0.8778em;vertical-align:-0.1944em;"></span><span class="mord text"><span class="mord">pointerNDC.y</span></span><span class="mspace" style="margin-right:0.2222em;"></span><span class="mbin">×</span><span class="mspace" style="margin-right:0.2222em;"></span></span><span class="base"><span class="strut" style="height:1.2772em;vertical-align:-0.345em;"></span><span class="mord"><span class="mopen nulldelimiter"></span><span class="mfrac"><span class="vlist-t vlist-t2"><span class="vlist-r"><span class="vlist" style="height:0.9322em;"><span style="top:-2.655em;"><span class="pstrut" </ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-11">2.5 场景隔离与 FBO 离屏渲染时序</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-12">1. <code>const buffer = useFBO()</code></h4>
<ul>
<li>初始化时仅在显存中开辟一块渲染缓冲（此时纹理内无有效像素数据）。</li>
<li>数据写入发生在 <code>useFrame</code> 中调用 <code>gl.render(scene, camera)</code> 时。</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-13">2. <code>createPortal(children, scene)</code></h4>
<ul>
<li>将 React 子节点（文字与图片）挂载到独立的 <code>scene</code>（<code>new THREE.Scene()</code>）。</li>
<li>这些元素脱离默认场景树，不会直接渲染到屏幕上，专门用于 FBO 离屏绘制。</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-14">2.6 双材质设计：底图平面与透射材质</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx">  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;&gt;</span>
      {createPortal(children, scene)}

      {/* 1. 底层：全屏背景平面 */}

<table><thead><tr><th align="left">材质与参数</th><th align="left">数据源</th><th align="left">作用与机制</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td align="left"><strong><code>meshBasicMaterial</code></strong><br><code>map={buffer.texture}</code></td><td align="left"><code>buffer.texture</code></td><td align="left"><strong>无光照贴图</strong>：将 FBO 内容 1:1 贴满视口，作为未被透镜遮挡时的正常背景底图。</td></tr><tr><td align="left"><strong><code>MeshTransmissionMaterial</code></strong><br><code>buffer={buffer.texture}</code></td><td align="left"><code>buffer.texture</code></td><td align="left"><strong>透射折射采样源</strong>：片元着色器根据网格法线、<code>ior</code>（折射率）、<code>thickness</code>（厚度）和 <code>chromaticAberration</code>（色散）对纹理进行偏移动态采样。</td></tr></tbody></table>

<h2 data-id="heading-15">3. 场景组件与模式切换</h2>

<ul>
<li><strong><code>Lens</code></strong>：圆柱透镜网格，跟随指针。</li>
<li><strong><code>Cube</code></strong>：立方体网格，呈现多面折射，跟随指针。</li>
<li><strong><code>Bar</code></strong>：长条网格，固定在视口底部，作为底部毛玻璃导航栏。</li>
</ul>

<h3 data-id="heading-18">3.3 响应式排版组件 <code>Typography</code> 与 <code>NavItems</code></h3>

    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Text</span>
      <span class="hljs-attr">position</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{[0,</span> <span class="hljs-attr">0</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">12</span>]}

    &gt;</span>
      React Bits
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">Text</span>&gt;</span></span>

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">NavItems</span>(<span class="hljs-params">{ items }: { items: { label: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>; link: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span> }[] }</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> group = useRef&lt;<span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-property">Group</span>&gt;(<span class="hljs-literal">null</span>);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { viewport, camera } = <span class="hljs-title function_">useThree</span>();
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">DEVICE</span> = {
    <span class="hljs-attr">mobile</span>: { <span class="hljs-attr">max</span>: <span class="hljs-number">639</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">spacing</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0.2</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">fontSize</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0.035</span> },
    <span class="hljs-attr">tablet</span>: { <span class="hljs-attr">max</span>: <span class="hljs-number">1023</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">spacing</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0.24</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">fontSize</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0.035</span> },
    <span class="hljs-attr">desktop</span>: { <span class="hljs-attr">max</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Infinity</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">spacing</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0.3</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">fontSize</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0.035</span> },
  };
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> getDevice = (): keyof <span class="hljs-keyword">typeof</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">DEVICE</span> =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> width = <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">innerWidth</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> width &lt;= <span class="hljs-variable constant_">DEVICE</span>.<span class="hljs-property">mobile</span>.<span class="hljs-property">max</span> ? <span class="hljs-string">'mobile'</span> : width &lt;= <span class="hljs-variable constant_">DEVICE</span>.<span class="hljs-property">tablet</span>.<span class="hljs-property">max</span> ? <span class="hljs-string">'tablet'</span> : <span class="hljs-string">'desktop'</span>;
  };
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [device, setDevice] = <span class="hljs-title function_">useState</span>(getDevice);

  <span class="hljs-title function_">useEffect</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">onResize</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; <span class="hljs-title function_">setDevice</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">getDevice</span>());
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'resize'</span>, onResize);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">removeEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'resize'</span>, onResize);
  }, []);

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { spacing, fontSize } = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">DEVICE</span>[device];

  <span class="hljs-title function_">useFrame</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> nav = group.<span class="hljs-property">current</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!nav) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> view = viewport.<span class="hljs-title function_">getCurrentViewport</span>(camera, [<span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">15</span>]);
    nav.<span class="hljs-property">position</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">set</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0</span>, -view.<span class="hljs-property">height</span> / <span class="hljs-number">2</span> + <span class="hljs-number">0.2</span>, <span class="hljs-number">15.1</span>);
    nav.<span class="hljs-property">children</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">child, index</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      child.<span class="hljs-property">position</span>.<span class="hljs-property">x</span> = (index - (items.<span class="hljs-property">length</span> - <span class="hljs-number">1</span>) / <span class="hljs-number">2</span>) * spacing;
    });
  });

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">group</span> <span class="hljs-attr">ref</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{group}</span> <span class="hljs-attr">renderOrder</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{10}</span>&gt;</span>
      {items.map(({ label }) =&gt; (
        <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Text</span>
          <span class="hljs-attr">key</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{label}</span>
          <span class="hljs-attr">fontSize</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{fontSize}</span>
          <span class="hljs-attr">color</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"white"</span>
          <span class="hljs-attr">anchorX</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"center"</span>
          <span class="hljs-attr">anchorY</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"middle"</span>
          <span class="hljs-attr">outlineWidth</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{0}</span>
          <span class="hljs-attr">outlineBlur</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"20%"</span>
          <span class="hljs-attr">outlineColor</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"#000"</span>
          <span class="hljs-attr">outlineOpacity</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{0.5}</span>
          <span class="hljs-attr">renderOrder</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{10}</span>

          {label}
        <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">Text</span>&gt;</span>

}

<h2 data-id="heading-24">5. 玻璃渲染方案对比</h2>









































<table><thead><tr><th align="left">维度</th><th align="left">Fluid Glass (<code>/fluid-glass.html</code>)</th><th align="left">Studio 四 Pass GLSL (<code>/</code>)</th><th align="left">SVG Filter (<code>/glass-svg.html</code>)</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td align="left"><strong>渲染技术</strong></td><td align="left">Three.js + R3F + FBO 离屏渲染</td><td align="left">WebGL 原生四 Pass (Offscreen FBO)</td><td align="left">原生 DOM + SVG 滤镜</td></tr><tr><td align="left"><strong>形状表现</strong></td><td align="left">3D 网格模型 (<code>.glb</code> 几何体)</td><td align="left">2D 符号距离场 (SDF)</td><td align="left">HTML DOM 盒模型</td></tr><tr><td align="left"><strong>折射机制</strong></td><td align="left">物理法线折射 (<code>MeshTransmissionMaterial</code>)</td><td align="left">GLSL 片元多重采样</td><td align="left"><code>feDisplacementMap</code> 像素位移</td></tr><tr><td align="left"><strong>色散支持</strong></td><td align="left">分通道 RGB 物理色散</td><td align="left">Shader 手动偏移采样色散</td><td align="left">伪色相偏移</td></tr><tr><td align="left"><strong>适用场景</strong></td><td align="left">3D 模型交互、物理透镜视觉特效</td><td align="left">参数化玻璃材质编辑器、高斯模糊背景</td><td align="left">轻量级纯网页 HTML UI 装饰</td></tr></tbody></table>

<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-comment">/* eslint-disable react/no-unknown-property */</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { memo, <span class="hljs-title class_">Suspense</span>, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, <span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ReactNode</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">FluidMode</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'lens'</span> | <span class="hljs-string">'cube'</span> | <span class="hljs-string">'bar'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ZoomMaterial</span> = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-property">MeshBasicMaterial</span> &amp; { <span class="hljs-attr">zoom</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span> };

<span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ModeWrapperProps</span> = {

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">LENS_GLB</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'/assets/3d/lens.glb'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">CUBE_GLB</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'/assets/3d/cube.glb'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ModeWrapper</span> = <span class="hljs-title function_">memo</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">ModeWrapper</span>(<span class="hljs-params">{

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> buffer = <span class="hljs-title function_">useFBO</span>();
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { viewport, gl } = <span class="hljs-title function_">useThree</span>();
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> scene = <span class="hljs-title function_">useMemo</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Scene</span>(), []);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> geoWidthRef = <span class="hljs-title function_">useRef</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1</span>);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> pointerNDC = <span class="hljs-title function_">useRef</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Vector2</span>());

  <span class="hljs-title function_">useEffect</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> geo = nodes[geometryKey]?.<span class="hljs-property">geometry</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!geo) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
    geo.<span class="hljs-title function_">computeBoundingBox</span>();
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> box = geo.<span class="hljs-property">boundingBox</span>;
    geoWidthRef.<span class="hljs-property">current</span> = box ? box.<span class="hljs-property">max</span>.<span class="hljs-property">x</span> - box.<span class="hljs-property">min</span>.<span class="hljs-property">x</span> || <span class="hljs-number">1</span> : <span class="hljs-number">1</span>;
  }, [nodes, geometryKey]);

  <span class="hljs-title function_">useEffect</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> canvas = gl.<span class="hljs-property">domElement</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">onMove</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">event: PointerEvent</span>) =&gt; {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> rect = canvas.<span class="hljs-title function_">getBoundingClientRect</span>();
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (rect.<span class="hljs-property">width</span> === <span class="hljs-number">0</span> || rect.<span class="hljs-property">height</span> === <span class="hljs-number">0</span>) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
      pointerNDC.<span class="hljs-property">current</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">set</span>(
        ((event.<span class="hljs-property">clientX</span> - rect.<span class="hljs-property">left</span>) / rect.<span class="hljs-property">width</span>) * <span class="hljs-number">2</span> - <span class="hljs-number">1</span>,
        -((event.<span class="hljs-property">clientY</span> - rect.<span class="hljs-property">top</span>) / rect.<span class="hljs-property">height</span>) * <span class="hljs-number">2</span> + <span class="hljs-number">1</span>,
      );
    };
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'pointermove'</span>, onMove);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">removeEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'pointermove'</span>, onMove);
  }, [gl]);

  <span class="hljs-title function_">useFrame</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">state, delta</span>) =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> mesh = meshRef.<span class="hljs-property">current</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!mesh) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { gl, camera } = state;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> view = viewport.<span class="hljs-title function_">getCurrentViewport</span>(camera, [<span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">15</span>]);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> destX = followPointer ? (pointerNDC.<span class="hljs-property">current</span>.<span class="hljs-property">x</span> * view.<span class="hljs-property">width</span>) / <span class="hljs-number">2</span> : <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> destY = lockToBottom
      ? -view.<span class="hljs-property">height</span> / <span class="hljs-number">2</span> + <span class="hljs-number">0.2</span>
      : followPointer
        ? (pointerNDC.<span class="hljs-property">current</span>.<span class="hljs-property">y</span> * view.<span class="hljs-property">height</span>) / <span class="hljs-number">2</span>
        : <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
    easing.<span class="hljs-title function_">damp3</span>(mesh.<span class="hljs-property">position</span>, [destX, destY, <span class="hljs-number">15</span>], <span class="hljs-number">0.15</span>, delta);

    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (modeProps.<span class="hljs-property">scale</span> == <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> maxWorld = view.<span class="hljs-property">width</span> * <span class="hljs-number">0.9</span>;
      mesh.<span class="hljs-property">scale</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">setScalar</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">min</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0.15</span>, maxWorld / geoWidthRef.<span class="hljs-property">current</span>));
    }

    gl.<span class="hljs-title function_">setRenderTarget</span>(buffer);
    gl.<span class="hljs-title function_">render</span>(scene, camera);
    gl.<span class="hljs-title function_">setRenderTarget</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">null</span>);
    gl.<span class="hljs-title function_">setClearColor</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0x5227ff</span>, <span class="hljs-number">1</span>);
  });

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> {
    scale,
    ior,
    thickness,
    anisotropy,
    chromaticAberration,
    ...extraMat
  } = modeProps <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">FluidGlassProps</span> &amp; <span class="hljs-title class_">Record</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, <span class="hljs-built_in">unknown</span>&gt;;

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;&gt;</span>
      {createPortal(children, scene)}
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">mesh</span> <span class="hljs-attr">scale</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{[viewport.width,</span> <span class="hljs-attr">viewport.height</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">1</span>]}&gt;</span>
        <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">planeGeometry</span> /&gt;</span>
        <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">meshBasicMaterial</span> <span class="hljs-attr">map</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{buffer.texture}</span> <span class="hljs-attr">transparent</span> /&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">mesh</span>&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">mesh</span>
        <span class="hljs-attr">ref</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{meshRef}</span>
        <span class="hljs-attr">scale</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{(scale</span> <span class="hljs-attr">as</span> <span class="hljs-attr">number</span> | <span class="hljs-attr">undefined</span>) ?? <span class="hljs-attr">0.15</span>}
        <span class="hljs-attr">rotation-x</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{Math.PI</span> / <span class="hljs-attr">2</span>}
        <span class="hljs-attr">geometry</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{nodes[geometryKey]?.geometry}</span>
      &gt;</span>
        <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">MeshTransmissionMaterial</span>
          <span class="hljs-attr">buffer</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{buffer.texture}</span>
          <span class="hljs-attr">ior</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{(ior</span> <span class="hljs-attr">as</span> <span class="hljs-attr">number</span> | <span class="hljs-attr">undefined</span>) ?? <span class="hljs-attr">1.15</span>}
          <span class="hljs-attr">thickness</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{(thickness</span> <span class="hljs-attr">as</span> <span class="hljs-attr">number</span> | <span class="hljs-attr">undefined</span>) ?? <span class="hljs-attr">5</span>}
          <span class="hljs-attr">anisotropy</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{(anisotropy</span> <span class="hljs-attr">as</span> <span class="hljs-attr">number</span> | <span class="hljs-attr">undefined</span>) ?? <span class="hljs-attr">0.01</span>}
          <span class="hljs-attr">chromaticAberration</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{(chromaticAberration</span> <span class="hljs-attr">as</span> <span class="hljs-attr">number</span> | <span class="hljs-attr">undefined</span>) ?? <span class="hljs-attr">0.1</span>}
          {<span class="hljs-attr">...extraMat</span>}

  );
});

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">FluidGlass</span>(<span class="hljs-params">{
  mode = <span class="hljs-string">'lens'</span>,
  scale = <span class="hljs-number">0.2</span>,
  ior = <span class="hljs-number">1.15</span>,
  thickness = <span class="hljs-number">2</span>,
  chromaticAberration = <span class="hljs-number">0.05</span>,
  anisotropy = <span class="hljs-number">0.01</span>,
}: FluidGlassProps</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Wrapper</span> = mode === <span class="hljs-string">'bar'</span> ? <span class="hljs-title class_">Bar</span> : mode === <span class="hljs-string">'cube'</span> ? <span class="hljs-title class_">Cube</span> : <span class="hljs-title class_">Lens</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> modeProps = {
    scale,
    ior,
    thickness,
    chromaticAberration,
    anisotropy,
    <span class="hljs-attr">transmission</span>: <span class="hljs-number">1</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">roughness</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,
  };

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Canvas</span> <span class="hljs-attr">camera</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{{</span> <span class="hljs-attr">position:</span> [<span class="hljs-attr">0</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">0</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">20</span>], <span class="hljs-attr">fov:</span> <span class="hljs-attr">15</span> }} <span class="hljs-attr">gl</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{{</span> <span class="hljs-attr">alpha:</span> <span class="hljs-attr">true</span> }}&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Suspense</span> <span class="hljs-attr">fallback</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{null}</span>&gt;</span>
        <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">ScrollControls</span> <span class="hljs-attr">damping</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{0.2}</span> <span class="hljs-attr">pages</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{3}</span> <span class="hljs-attr">distance</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{0.4}</span>&gt;</span>
          {mode === 'bar' &amp;&amp; (
            <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">NavItems</span>
              <span class="hljs-attr">items</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{[</span>
                { <span class="hljs-attr">label:</span> '<span class="hljs-attr">Home</span>', <span class="hljs-attr">link:</span> '' },

          )}
          <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Wrapper</span> <span class="hljs-attr">modeProps</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{modeProps}</span>&gt;</span>
            <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Scroll</span>&gt;</span>
              <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Typography</span> /&gt;</span>

<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-26">7. 相关文档与参考资源</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-27">7.1 本项目不同玻璃实现模块与页面</h3>






























<table><thead><tr><th align="left">模块页面</th><th align="left">源码目录</th><th align="left">技术方案与特征</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td align="left"><strong>流体 3D 玻璃透镜</strong> (<code>/fluid-glass.html</code>)</td><td align="left"><code>src/fluid-glass/</code></td><td align="left">Three.js + R3F + FBO 离屏渲染 + GLB 3D 模型透射折射</td></tr><tr><td align="left"><strong>材质实验室主工作台</strong> (<code>/</code>)</td><td align="left"><code>src/</code> (<code>App.tsx</code>, <code>shaders/</code>)</td><td align="left">WebGL2/WebGPU + 四 Pass 高斯模糊与 SDF 物理光学着色</td></tr><tr><td align="left"><strong>毛玻璃悬浮交互按键</strong> (<code>/glass-buttons.html</code>)</td><td align="left"><code>src/glass-buttons/</code></td><td align="left">DOM 捕获 + Shader Overlay 玻璃浮层</td></tr><tr><td align="left"><strong>SVG 滤镜轻量玻璃</strong> (<code>/glass-svg.html</code>)</td><td align="left"><code>src/glass-svg/</code></td><td align="left">纯 DOM + SVG <code>feDisplacementMap</code> 位移滤镜</td></tr></tbody></table>
<h3 data-id="heading-28">7.2 核心参考库与规范</h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fr3f.docs.pmnd.rs%2F" target="_blank" title="https://r3f.docs.pmnd.rs/" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">React Three Fiber (R3F) 官方文档</a>：React 声明式 Three.js 渲染器。</li>
<li><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fpmndrs%2Fdrei%23meshtransmissionmaterial" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/pmndrs/drei#meshtransmissionmaterial" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">@react-three/drei - MeshTransmissionMaterial</a>：基于物理折射率 (IOR)、色散与厚度的体透射材质组件。</li>
<li><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fthreejs.org%2Fdocs%2F%23api%2Fen%2Frenderers%2FWebGLRenderTarget" target="_blank" title="https://threejs.org/docs/#api/en/renderers/WebGLRenderTarget" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Three.js 官方文档 - WebGLRenderTarget (FBO)</a>：离屏帧缓冲对象 API 规范。</li>
<li><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fpmndrs%2Fmaath" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/pmndrs/maath" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">pmndrs/maath</a>：用于 3D 物理运动与相机平滑插值的数学库 (<code>easing.damp3</code>)。</li>
</ul></div></div>
